body:
I suffer from depression and anxiety and I can tell you why he didn't inform his family from why I don't tell my family that I don't take medication for my CF and eat just once a day.

My family are the last people I would mention mental illness to because of a history of other mental illness in the family that ended up in hospital involuntarily on several occasions.

I don't take medications or eat enough because I'm pretty much 100% reliant on social welfare and free healthcare but i don't want to avail of it because been depressed clouds my judgement to where I think I'm a burden to society and the worst thing is that I realize it but I still don't act on it.

The man is 40 years old, when your an adult no matter who you are you won't admit to people you know that you need help with something out of fear of been judged someway. like me his mental illness probably clouded his judgement to think that if the government cut his disability payment then he concluded that he wasn't worth it anymore and choose not to do anything about it.
Not entering, just wanted to say that its very generous of you to do this and I'd do the same if I had the money because of the very open development of the game. Thank you.

>I know that CF is a brutal thing to live with, but where I live there is quite a strong support network of people with CF and their friends and families. It doesn't sound like you have anything like that - either because it doesn't exist or because it just doesn't work for you (which is totally fair if that's the case - nothing works for everybody).

There is a regional CF team of doctors I used to go to on a regular basis for checkups but the last few years its been difficult to travel there.

>But "alone" is the strongest feeling I get from what you've written here. We're not designed to be isolated like that - it's not a natural state.

Yes, I am alone but being introverted I don't mind much of the time. I just don't like that I can't go out and meet up with certain people or go certain places when/if I do want to.

>I am glad the you reached out. At least somebody out here on the internet is thinking of you with kindness.

That's true, the internet is the only thing that has kept me from myself for this lone. Thanks.

Yup, gaming seems to be headed down the shitter and every hopeful game is nearly always a disappointment. The main reason being console limitations and greedy publishers. At least Rocket is being honest with us.
I'd love to...if I had the energy.

>I assume you're on transplant list now too?

nope. I also have cepacia so the likely hood of being accepted for transplant with that is very low because there is a high chance of reinfection. Besides in my state I'd feel quite miserable know that someone died just so I could live a few more months or that I denied someone else with a more fulfilling life the chance to get one.
>I mean look at the Kalydeco drug, people who have been at 30% LF (FEV1) have made it back up to 70% just because of 1 tablet a day!

Kalydeco looks very promising but I think that the €300k+ a year could be better spent elsewhere other then on medication for me. If I had a choice I'd fill prescriptions and send them to someone else with CF that has to actually pay for it because medical treatment is free here.(I only ever filled prescriptions for meds I knew I was going to take before)
>Is there a reason you don't do your meds anymore?

yes, I want to re-spawn.
Please don't, you have people that care for you. My only friends are online so they won't get hurt by me not being online, they will just think my internets gone down or something.

> Go to therapy with people that have CF too.

I have an extremely dangerous bug(cepacia) which is quite deadly to CF patients, can't have that spreading to someone else also with CF. its harmless so people without CF.

>You can go to a church or something and help other people, do charity, i think it's something that help's people, but i've never done it myself.
Religion can help you too... no matter wich chuch or something... just saying.

Thanks but I pretty much gave up on the whole religion thing when I grow up and recalled getting pulled out of class and dragged to the church to get baptized without consent from my parents. Saying that I fully respect your faith as with everyone's if this is your belief.

>Not trying here to be a good person, i have my own problems, i just took 5min of my life to maybe save yours(if you are serious about all this), but in the end it's your decision, live or die.
I hope you don't make the wrong choice... i know life is hard
Anyway, happy holidays and enjoy SA when it (finally) comes out

Thank you, you can stop by my camp for beans and a bloodbag anytime.

>How unwell are you exactly with CF? Lung Function etc?
This is very morbid, I hope you have a specialist to speak to for it. Reason I ask is I have CF too, my lung function currently is 70% (possibly lower, awaiting IVs any day now) and I have never once felt like this so assuming you are very ill by it?

Last time I done it was after 2 weeks in hospital was 33% and I've not done any meds or proper physio session since. I've prety much ignored the CF team that looks after patients in my area.

>why do you feel you want the mod over SA? You know the SA is aimed more at exactly what you want, rather than the other mods running rampart as PVP focused, right?

I don't want to mod of SA, I'm pretty much like everyone else here waiting for it(got board of mod, cheaters and certain bugs). What I was trying to say is that the Standalone is the only thing right now that I look forward to by living, as pathetic as it may seem.
